t: Reyda | Elder Scrolls | Fandom
s: June 7, 2025 - Reyda is a deceased Nord and the sister of Narfi in The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. Her skeletal remains, along with a satchel which contains her necklace, can be found in the bottom of the river southeast of Ivarstead. Reyda used to live together with her brother Narfi in the family home in Ivarstead.
